sections.text:
XXIII, p. 49. Plura in libro de sphaera barbarica quem propediem emissurus est, edet
Franciscus Boll cui haec debemus. Totum opusculum divulgabit Weigl Monacensis.
sections.en: XXIII, p. 49. More in the book on the barbarian sphere which he is about to publish very soon, Franciscus Boll will edit, to whom we owe these things. Weigl of Munich will publish the whole little work.

summary.headline: Astrological Questions 131–148
summary.text: Catalog entries 131–148 of a Venetian astrological codex, covering judgments on travelers, marriage, diseases, runaways, surgery, crafts, planting, bonds, stolen goods, beginnings, lots, zodiacal and planetary elements, star turning, life or death, inquiry, oracles, and the twelfth parts of the zodiac.
